newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hostage-takers reported off Nigerian barge.
newsitem.headline: Hostage-takers reported off Nigerian barge.

text.p: An oil industry barge taken hostage in Nigeria no longer has any un-authorised people on board, a spokeswoman for the French oil contracting firm ETPM said on Thursday.

"All I can say is that the barge has resumed moving toward the sea and the only people aboard are its 20 expatriate and 70 local employees. We don't know exactly what happened to lead to this but there are no more unauthorised people aboard," she told Reuters.

Reports from Lagos earlier said delicate negotiations were underway to try to free the crew from local people demanding jobs, although the Nigerian government said no foreigners had been taken hostage and the barge had been freed by the intervention of security agents.
"I don't know anything about security agents or rescue operations and cannot immediately check because we don't have radio contact for the moment," the spokeswoman said.
"But indeed there were people aboard before with whom we were negotiating about employment and they are no longer aboard," she said.
